s3-1000-buckets.statement: SaaS Security API scans cover up to 1,000 Amazon S3 buckets, and enabling that, or Amazon S3 at all, goes through the Zscaler Account team.

quotes: To enable scanning of up to 1,000 Amazon S3 buckets, contact your Zscaler Account team.
To enable Amazon S3 for your organization, contact your Zscaler Account team.

gcp-azure-1000.statement: SaaS Security API scans cover up to 1,000 Google Cloud Platform buckets and 1,000 Azure blob containers, each raised through the Zscaler Account team.

quotes: To enable scanning of up to 1,000 Google Cloud Platform buckets, contact your Zscaler Account team.
To enable scanning of up to 1,000 Azure blob containers, contact your Zscaler Account team.

bitbucket-32.statement: SaaS Security API scans cover up to 32 Bitbucket repositories.

sub-url-in-saas-logs.title: Whether the Sub-URL limit applies to SaaS Security logs
sub-url-in-saas-logs.detail: The ranges article states the 2,041-character limit for "Insight Logs display and CSV file" among the Insights features; the SaaS Security Insights column lists have no Sub-URL column, so no source ties the limit to SaaS Security logs.
